The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has locked down the entire U.S.-Mexico border airspace to drones through 2027 to counter cartel threats [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNdDg1dDI4Mm9ZVWhPUWc5RWxadlR5dFZHR0JENjU5QmVXRDBSVWJmTGxidzJqYXVheTQzeEJVLUtST0lVeHFtaDJkRVBrcVI5bExHRTg5M3FNSGF0REtOb0o5S3dERk42OUoxZWFqdFVaemkxclh2US1HaHVLblE2ZjBvenVkRHFKckJwZGNNQ2pySXd0TVUtbjh4akhPVUJiRlE]. This restriction on unauthorized drones [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNaTRkbXdPSWpZWW8yY3pHcm1rNVhmOWlDU1gzMFVvMW9XXy1WaU41ekxZVUJQdFlqNHhtSVh6elg0NHNqeWtNekE3dFFGWHQ1Y0c5VnhZMVJnRW9ROFRZUkpITF83WWJuSDVjWjQ2NFdsMUY2QXM2M0FzUGFlTzNUWEhrSnJPT0dUNldZVzZjZlg3RWZfTWVkWVZ4amJvQ05DTkdIcmQzdlJQc1Y2b1U5UQ] coincides with broader efforts to advance counter-UAS capabilities, including a strategic collaboration agreement between Echodyne and ACS [https://news.google.] and the one-year anniversary of the Department of Defense's Joint Interagency Task Force 401 [https://www.war.gov/News/News-Stories/Article/Article/4626931/joint-interagency-task-force-401-marks-one-year-of-accelerating-counter-uas-cap/].

The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) opened a probe into Tesla robotaxis for speeding and ignoring school zones [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE8zQThsSmRPZXVoOHRjRmt6QllXU1lQYkJuQ0o1ckdVX2lDbmg0Nk4yTnlyamxqU0lnanc2Qk1sdVJZMlFRUE1BN1lwSFZiVzl3U2NBWFBWN1I5VDA4cEZFUHBEdkNYb1JhLS0xbmtCNlduQ1E]. While latest NHTSA data records no major incidents for the Tesla Cybercab [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNQUxDN1pTU2pteUZaVTcxR3BRN3QxOExzdGVtYl9CYzFwbDZlSkRva0FnYlk1ek1DVzYtbFhCMlJNdWFFcTFYVHA2cklXdDNzZHl5dGYtVGg3RjZDY3NfWEw5bEdIQ1NEVTRxR1BZenpSaTRtWm5oa3Yxd1hTRzVEVUdB], the company is expected to defend the vehicle in November [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE03Z2hkdXlxdGc4OEM2dFF2dENFSFJva21aakdXRDRhZjVtdTh2TzBoTkU3cWhwd1ZZT1k2cEt1cVE0X0VCUEtCRzZSblBGZmw4eVdoSE1xc1lBNjZMR0pkMTExR3VmYzNRaE5v?oc=5]. These events highlight increasing regulatory scrutiny of autonomous vehicle scaling and safety [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPalRRSzVOTnFSYlZIbUh2SWkyalp3bHNZbXFGdGs2MzZBTHVtTGFnemNDZ0pTYnQ5LXNiMXRVNTBBaExvNVc4ZTZGcmliTmQ1TVp0Q1M1OHpRdGo1WHdhVHdIWWpjal9MOHJodW5EY0xnZndJbW9wa3FwMmctM2tXQzN0WEpZQ2hYUlFxdkVDSDRmMkpoclVvNzdn?oc=5].

In advanced aviation, U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced the first-ever Special Airworthiness Market Survey Certificate for eVTOL aircraft and New Mexico’s first demonstration flight under the Electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing Integration Pilot Program [https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-announces-first-ever-special-airworthiness]. Additionally, the FAA issued certification for the Boeing 737 MAX-10 [https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/federal-aviation-administration-issues-certification-boeing-737-max-10] and adopted a new airworthiness directive for certain Boeing 737 series airplanes [https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/19/2026-21332/airworthiness-directives-the-boeing-company-airplanes].
